messages.subject: Joint model
parts:
Hello friends,

I'm trying to fit a joint mode with three variables (two binary and one survival)
I want to share the random effects from model 1 and model 2 with survival model like expression below:


 

I tried to run the code below:

joint.inla3 <- INLA::inla(Y ~ -1 +
    #Intercepts
        inter +
    # Model 1
    sexo.m1 + idade.m1 +
    f(idx.sh.m1, model = "iid") +
     
    # Model 2
    sexo.m2 + idade.m2 +
    f(idx.sh.m2, model = "iid") +
   
    #Survival model
    sexo.s + idade.s +
    f(idx.sh.s,  copy = c("idx.sh.m1","idx.sh.m2"), fixed = FALSE),
    data = joint.data3,
    family = c("binomial", "binomial", "weibull.surv")
   ,verbose=TRUE
    )


and the message is:

*** ERROR *** ffield 2 is F_COPY and a copy of idx.sh.l idx.sh.l2 which is not found
